metadata.question: Were there more snow in north-central Chile in July, 16 2022 than July 7, 2022?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy:
   - Use MODIS daily snow cover: Terra (MODIS/061/MOD10A1), fallback to Aqua (MODIS/061/MYD10A1).
   - Compare two dates: 2022-07-07 and 2022-07-16.
   - ROI: an inland north-central Chile rectangle (lon [-71.8,-69.2], lat [-32.5,-26.5]) to avoid ocean bias.
2. Masking strategy:
   - Use NDSI_Snow_Cover band; keep valid pixels 0–100; define snow as NDSI_Snow_Cover > 10.
   - No extra cloud masking (product already accounts for it).
3. Logic for validity:
   - If both Terra and Aqua have zero images for a day, try a ±1 day window. If still none => C1.
   - If valid pixels after masking are 0 => C2.
   - If any computed value is null/NaN or outside reasonable bounds => C3.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([-71.8, -32.5, -69.2, -26.5], null, false);
    const d1 = '2022-07-07';
    const d2 = '2022-07-16';
    const scale = 1000;
    const maxPixels = 1e9;
    const ndsiBand = 'NDSI_Snow_Cover';
    const snowThreshold = 10; // percent

    const terraId = 'MODIS/061/MOD10A1';
    const aquaId  = 'MODIS/061/MYD10A1';

    async function getBestDailyImage(dateStr) {
      // Try exact day, Terra then Aqua
      const date = ee.Date(dateStr);
      const next = date.advance(1, 'day');
      let colT = ee.ImageCollection(terraId).filterDate(date, next).filterBounds(geom).select(ndsiBand);
      let colA = ee.ImageCollection(aquaId).filterDate(date, next).filterBounds(geom).select(ndsiBand);
      let sizeT = await colT.size().getInfo();
      let sizeA = await colA.size().getInfo();

      let used = null;
      let window = 'D1';
      if (sizeT > 0) {
        used = colT.mosaic().set({sensor: 'Terra'});
      } else if (sizeA > 0) {
        used = colA.mosaic().set({sensor: 'Aqua'});
      } else {
        // Widen window ±1 day
        const startW = date.advance(-1, 'day');
        const endW = date.advance(2, 'day');
        colT = ee.ImageCollection(terraId).filterDate(startW, endW).filterBounds(geom).select(ndsiBand);
        colA = ee.ImageCollection(aquaId).filterDate(startW, endW).filterBounds(geom).select(ndsiBand);
        sizeT = await colT.size().getInfo();
        sizeA = await colA.size().getInfo();
        window = 'W3';
        if (sizeT > 0) {
          used = colT.mosaic().set({sensor: 'Terra'});
        } else if (sizeA > 0) {
          used = colA.mosaic().set({sensor: 'Aqua'});
        }
      }
      return { img: used, counts: { terra: sizeT, aqua: sizeA, window } };
    }

    async function snowStats(img) {
      // Valid mask: 0..100
      const valid = img.select(ndsiBand).gte(0).and(img.select(ndsiBand).lte(100));
      const validImg = img.updateMask(valid);
      const countValid = await validImg.select(ndsiBand).reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get(ndsiBand).getInfo();

      if (countValid === null || countValid === 0) {
        return { valid: countValid || 0, snow: 0, pct: null };
      }

      const snowBin = validImg.select(ndsiBand).gt(snowThreshold).rename('snow');
      const snowCount = await snowBin.reduceRegion({
        reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
        geometry: geom,
        scale: scale,
        maxPixels: maxPixels
      }).get('snow').getInfo();

      if (snowCount === null) {
        return { valid: countValid, snow: null, pct: null };
      }
      const pct = (snowCount / countValid) * 100.0;
      return { valid: countValid, snow: snowCount, pct: pct };
    }

    // 2. Data Acquisition & Check
    const d1Data = await getBestDailyImage(d1);
    const d2Data = await getBestDailyImage(d2);

    if (!d1Data.img && !d2Data.img) {
      console.log(`No data both days. D1(T:${d1Data.counts.terra},A:${d1Data.counts.aqua}) D2(T:${d2Data.counts.terra},A:${d2Data.counts.aqua})`);
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
      return;
    }
    if (!d1Data.img) {
      console.log(`No data ${d1}. T:${d1Data.counts.terra} A:${d1Data.counts.aqua}`);
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
      return;
    }
    if (!d2Data.img) {
      console.log(`No data ${d2}. T:${d2Data.counts.terra} A:${d2Data.counts.aqua}`);
      console.log('C1: Empty Collection');
      return;
    }

    // 3. Processing
    const s1 = await snowStats(d1Data.img);
    const s2 = await snowStats(d2Data.img);

    // Handle C2 (no valid pixels)
    if (s1.valid === 0 || s2.valid === 0) {
      console.log(`Valid pixels zero. ${d1}=${s1.valid}, ${d2}=${s2.valid}`);
      console.log('C2: No Valid Pixels');
      return;
    }

    // 4. Calculation Validation
    const invalid1 = (s1.pct === null || isNaN(s1.pct));
    const invalid2 = (s2.pct === null || isNaN(s2.pct));
    if (invalid1 || invalid2) {
      console.log(`Calc failure. ${d1} pct:${s1.pct} ${d2} pct:${s2.pct}`);
      console.log('C3: Calculation Failure');
      return;
    }

    // 5. Output concise evidence and final answer
    const line1 = `Collections ${d1}[${d1Data.counts.window}]: T=${d1Data.counts.terra} A=${d1Data.counts.aqua} | ${d2}[${d2Data.counts.window}]: T=${d2Data.counts.terra} A=${d2Data.counts.aqua}`;
    console.log(line1);
    console.log(`${d1} Valid:${s1.valid} SnowPx:${s1.snow} Snow%:${s1.pct.toFixed(2)}`);
    console.log(`${d2} Valid:${s2.valid} SnowPx:${s2.snow} Snow%:${s2.pct.toFixed(2)}`);

    const moreSnow = s2.pct > s1.pct;
    console.log(moreSnow ? 'A: Yes' : 'B: No');
  } catch (e) {
    console.log(`Error: ${e}`);
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
